context.title: Faith in Action Bay Area: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Establishing a Municipal Finance Corporation and a Public Bank)

positions.statement: Faith in Action signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)
